story-info.story-title:
Implement Sum to N Specification and Proofs Homework 2: Recursion and Loops ready-for-dev
Story 1 (Factorial) - for pattern reference

technical-requirements.proof-mode: Can use `nonlinear_arith` mode OR specific lemmas

spec-pattern.step: 1. Define recursive spec function sum_to_n with decreases clause
5. Implement iterative exec function with loop invariant

library-framework-requirements.no-external-crates: All functionality must use vstd library only

file-structure-requirements.verification-block: All code must be inside `verus! { }` block

development-testing.note: Can write normal `#[test]` functions and use `cargo test` to verify implementations before attempting proofs
development-testing.pattern: Write tests first to ensure implementations work, then add proofs

verification-requirements.requirement: Monotonicity proof must complete (should be trivial)
Both implementations must verify and match spec

monotonicity-proof.note: This should be trivial - Verus doesn't need help

formula-proof.intermediate-step: May need to prove: n * (n - 1) + n + n == n * ((n - 1) + 2)

loop-invariant-pattern.requirement: Use monotonic lemma for overflow reasoning

critical-constraints.constraint: Must follow same pattern as factorial (Story 1)
Monotonicity proof should be automatic - don't overcomplicate
Formula proof is the main challenge - use lemmas strategically
Both implementations must match spec exactly

common-pitfalls.pitfall: Not using distributive lemma for intermediate algebraic steps
Forgetting to prove the intermediate step: n * (n - 1) + n + n == n * ((n - 1) + 2)
Not following factorial pattern closely enough

success-criteria.criterion: Formula equivalence proof completes: n * (n + 1) / 2 == sum_to_n(n)
All implementations return same value as spec
